text: Onto science now, and Queensland researchers have been busy building a smarter AI tool that can flag bushfire risk zones weeks out from the danger season. It crunches vegetation and weather data to spot the trouble spots before they become actual trouble.

speaker: alice
text: That is genuinely brilliant, giving crews a head start instead of playing catch up when the mercury climbs. It is the kind of quiet science win that does not make huge headlines but could save homes and bushland down the track.
